_doc: One entry for each era that the curation of 15/11/2026 converts, mirroring the sheet of decisions (docs/2026-11-15-eras-decisoes.md of the stremio repository). `who`: marco = Marco's own answer; session = a choice of the session authorized by Marco on 15/11/2026 ('Apply the research's recommendation in each, and show me the result'); session-differs = the session did not follow the research. `curation` = the snapshot in research/2026-11-15-curadoria/. `admit` = the classes of the curation that enter (core = 2 or more independent sources, periphery = 1, disputed = one names it and another contradicts); `minSources` = how many sources a film needs; `institutions` = at least one source that is not Wikipedia; `dropDocs` = documentaries out; `removeDirectors` / `addDirectors` change the list of directors of the previous round; `include` = films a decision puts in whatever their class (and outside the years, as a written exception); `exclude` = written exclusions (a reason and a source each); `dropTitles` = films left out of the list with no written exclusion.
